string.text: The Zone breathes, %name%. I walk in its breath.
The sky burns for you. I am what it sends.
You hide from the Zone's breath. I was born in it.
The walls will not save you. The Zone has sealed every door.
Every emission the Zone chooses one. Tonight it chose you, %name%.
Stay inside, %name%. I am coming in.
The storm is my road. Your shelter is your grave.
Pray, if you know how. The Zone is listening, and so am I.
The storm has passed. The Zone will send me again.
You lasted the night, %name%. There will be other nights.
You ran from the shelter, %name%. The Zone ran with you.
Another map, the same sky. I am still walking.
%boss% is silent. The Zone gives up what he carried: a stash.
The sinners' channel goes quiet, then a set of coordinates: %boss%'s stash.
Reloading, %name%?
The storm is over. The Zone will send me again, %name%.
Dawn after the emission. You lived. For now.
This shelter again, %name%? The Zone remembers it too.
Emission shielding holding. Walking in, %name%.
You thought the storm would cover you. It covers me.
Blowout protocol: targets shelter, we collect. You sheltered.
Your hiding spot is on my thermal, %name%.
Every exit is covered. Something out here is helping me.
Command calls this weather. I call it cover.
The Zone keeps you in. I am coming in.
No extraction during an emission. For you, none at all.
Storm is over. Operation window closed. Next one, %name%.
Recalled after the blowout. Your file stays open.
Left your shelter, %name%? Bad call in this weather.
Target relocated mid-emission. Still walking.
Operator %boss% is down. His cache coordinates were on the squad net.
Military channel: '%boss% KIA.' Then coordinates: his cache.
Reloading, %name%?
Ilarion Hrech
The emission boss is already on his way.
